title: Network Programming: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / information / Technology
instructions: Answer question and any other two

parts.text: With the aid of an example explain the concept of templates as used in Programming.
Outline a brief history of the Unix Operating system.
What ports do the following services use? i. File Transfer Protocol ii. Simple Mail Transfer Protocol iii. Domain Name System iv. Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure v. Telnet
Briefly describe the five sockets functions/system calls below: i. Socket() ii. Bind() iii. Connect() iv. Listen() v. Accept()
Explain the Boss/worker thread model giving an example as used in the context of pthreads.
Briefly explain the concepts of circuits and packets as used in network communications stating the major advantage and disadvantage for each one of them.
Give a brief description of the OSI model with the aid of a diagram.
Define synchronization as used in the context of pthreads.
Explain two methods of implementing thread synchronization.
Define inheritance and multiple inheritance as used in Object oriented programming.
With the aid of program segments explain an implementation of inheritance.
Information hiding and protection are two techniques that are used to implement encapsulation of an object. Briefly explain these two concepts.
UNIX is a multitasking Operating system, as well as being multiuser. Briefly explain these 2 concepts.
With the aid of a diagram explain the UNIX file system.
What do the following commands do in UNIX? i. #rmdir mystuff ii. #passwd wjohn iii. #pwd iv. #cd /usr/mine v. #ls vi. #vi file1
